f2p: is exposed on the shared dateTimeFormat surface
moments under a minute old render as the current moment
sub-minute moments honour the requested locale
formatTime defaults to the short time style
formatDate defaults to the medium date style
format defaults to medium date with short time
formatRange defaults to medium date with short time
maxVisibleItems caps the visible set when the container overflows
the overflow indicator is revealed while items are hidden
